title: A negative half-hour offset across daylight saving (St. John's, UTC-03:30 -> -02:30 on 2026-03-08)
policy: P14: a record belongs to the local day of its own timestamp, in any zone in use (every current offset is a multiple of 15 minutes). Today, the 7 days and the 30 days start at local midnight.
derivation: DST starts Mar 8 at 02:00 NST (05:30Z) -> 03:00 NDT, so Mar 8 has 23 hours. Midnights: Mar 8 00:00 NST = 03:30Z Mar 8; Mar 9 00:00 NDT = 02:30Z Mar 9; Mar 10 00:00 NDT = 02:30Z Mar 10. Now is 12:30 NDT Mar 10; the 7 and 30 days include everything. a 03:29:59Z Mar 8 = 23:59:59 NST Mar 7 (1). b 03:30Z = 00:00 Mar 8 (2). c 05:29Z = 01:59 NST (4), d 05:30Z = 03:00 NDT (8), both Mar 8. e 02:29:59Z Mar 9 = 23:59:59 NDT Mar 8 (16). f 02:30Z = 00:00 Mar 9 (32). g 02:30Z Mar 10 = 00:00 Mar 10 (64; streamed again in step 2 with output 5). h 02:29Z Mar 10 = 23:59 Mar 9 (128), request id only; its pair arrives in step 2 (#55, still incomplete). p 03:00Z Mar 10, Haiku, P9 flat 300 vs 100+100: [1, 1], 300 unresolved (a minimum, no dispute): known 6, minimum 300 x 1.25 = 375 micro-dollars. Step 1: Mar 7 = 1; Mar 8 = 2 + 4 + 8 + 16 = 30; Mar 9 = 32 + 128 = 160; Mar 10 = 64 + 302 = 366 = today; week = month = 557. Step 2: g +5 output: Mar 10 = today = 371, week = month = 562. Whole UTC hours put the 03:00Z Mar 8 bucket (23:30 NST) on Mar 7 and the 02:00Z buckets (23:30 NDT) on the earlier day: b on Mar 7, f on Mar 8, g on Mar 9.
